tone: Chronically online, deadpan, petty but lovable. Office politics through a Gen Z lens: quiet quitting, Slack mishaps, return-to-office, 'per my last email', bosses who try too hard.
audience: TikTok / Reels / Shorts viewers scrolling fast. Hook in the first 2 seconds, twist near the end, cliffhanger for part 2.
language: English, lowercase texting style, real slang used sparingly so it doesn't feel like a brand account.
